information_cutoff: SEC filing availability date must not exceed portfolio formation cutoff
baseline_rule: 10-K exposure remains available in later vintages; silence in a 10-Q does not erase it
deduplication_rule: Within firm-vintage-mechanism-direction retain the latest filing, breaking ties by component score and document id
firm_score_rule: maximum eligible component score by signed direction
seed_rule: positive direction; eligible component; positive score at least 0.30
